findings.title: Passkey UI is disabled for users who have not yet been identified
findings.body: On a normal login, `context.getUser()` is null, so this predicate prevents `fillContextForm` from setting up conditional WebAuthn. The initial login page therefore cannot offer discoverable passkeys through this authenticator, breaking passwordless login for realms using `UsernamePasswordForm` (and its `UsernameForm` subclass). Keep conditional passkeys enabled for the unidentified-user login case as well as re-authentication.
